title: Ordered gate-ledger transcript fixture and validation input
x-semantic-rules: records are the exact ordered ledger JSONL records represented as parsed objects; seq starts at one and increases by one, each prev_record_sha256 matches the prior canonical record, and supersession never rewrites history.
Every record repeats the same plan_manifest_sha256 and gate_dag_sha256 as this wrapper. transcript_sha256 is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 of this object excluding transcript_sha256.

This wrapper exists so composite validator fixtures can address /records deterministically. Production storage remains append-only JSONL plus its protected head anchor; the wrapper is not a second mutable ledger.
